interface.name: zwlr_screencopy_manager_v1

description.summary: screen capture manager protocol with Gatekeeper Zero-Trust authentication

interface.description: This protocol allows Wayland clients to request screen capture and frame copying. In Athanor OS, all screencopy requests must explicitly undergo Gatekeeper DBus authorization before frame access is granted.

request.name: capture_output
request.description: Requests frame copy for a specified output. Invokes Gatekeeper DBus authentication.

request.name: capture_output_region
request.description: Requests frame copy for a subregion of an output. Invokes Gatekeeper DBus authentication.

interface.name: zwlr_screencopy_frame_v1
interface.description: Represents a single screen capture frame. Frame content is populated only after Gatekeeper authentication succeeds.

request.name: copy
request.description: Copies captured screen buffer into client-provided wl_buffer.

description.summary: frame copy failed or permission denied by Gatekeeper
